content.text: You can now use two powerful AI plugins for Eventhouse: AI Embed Text Plugin and AI Chat Completion Prompt Plugin. Connect Eventhouse data to OpenAI-powered applications for advanced analytics and AI scenarios. For more information, see ai_embed_text (preview) and ai_chat_completion (preview).
